name: task-6
_ambiguities: Option indices are read as the option's original index (the position it had when created), so the stored value after the first drag is 1,2,0.
Separator is assumed to be a comma with no spaces ('1,2,0').
The stored value's initial state (before any drag) is not pinned.
The control type of the param-named control is not pinned (only its .value is read).
Random titles and option texts are not asserted.
The draggable attribute and drag event details are not pinned; drag is performed with the HTML5 drag tool.
